response.overview: 4 mildly intelligent, that's being very generous with that analysis, rock n rollers trying to make it to a gig at another dead end club, 6 socially retarded misfits, and one small deity all collide for a strange gathering in a rural farmhouse.A twisted tale of sinners sinning, suffering, and paying their dues. A hectic road trip in an autistic automible. Drug addiction, alcoholism, and child abuse. What more could you crave. How about some blasting rock n roll songs, and a few mysterious zombies for good measure all compressed into far too short of a time. Not enough for you huh? crucifixion more your thing. Well we provide one of those as well. Lofi gore effects prevail in this fun and frantic little film. Grade B prime cut!
response.title: Breakfast of Imbeciles
